title: Enter a reading from the panel: same dialog, forecasts nothing, re-evaluates
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a user with View work orders, on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on (maintenance_reminders flag).
  2. A work order carries an asset that is enrolled on a schedule (or carries a compliance record), with at least one service due soon, due today or overdue, e.g. unit 'ZZAUTOTEST Truck 12', service 'PM-A'.
  3. Open that work order and find the maintenance panel inside the asset card.
custom_steps:
1. Confirm the panel has no 'Enter a reading' control of its own (readings live above it).
  2. Enter a reading from the work order using the same dialog as the asset.
  3. Confirm the dialog forecasts nothing, and after saving the panel shows what moved and any service that just became due.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The panel carries no 'Enter a reading' control of its own; readings live above it, and an empty reading shows as needing one.
  • Entering a reading from the work order uses the same dialog as the asset and forecasts nothing.
  • A reading entered here re-evaluates the unit immediately, and a service that has just become due says so.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780 (Maintenance Reminders); story SV-10572 (S16, The maintenance panel on a work order); Chunk 2 MR spec (Confluence 897679389), Part 1 / S16; read 2 Oct 2026. Source-verified 2 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S16-N1: “The panel carries no `Enter a reading` control of its own. Readings live above it, and an empty reading shows as needing one”
  • S16-R12: “Entering a reading from the work order uses the same dialog as the asset. The dialog forecasts nothing, per S10-N4; once the reading is saved the panel shows what it moved, per S16-E1”
  • S16-E1: “A reading entered here re-evaluates the unit immediately, and a service that has just become due says so”
